title: Endpoint Definition
description: Network-level endpoint configuration for V2 provider manifests

base_url.description: Absolute base URL of the provider API

timeout_ms.description: Default timeout for requests in milliseconds

chat.description: Chat completions endpoint path (relative to base_url)

stt.description: Speech-to-text transcription endpoint path (relative to base_url)

tts.description: Text-to-speech synthesis endpoint path (relative to base_url)

rerank.description: Document reranking endpoint path (relative to base_url)

param_name.description: Query parameter name for query_param auth

token_env.description: Environment variable name for the API key

extra_headers.description: Additional headers to include in requests
